content.value: A git pull on prod fires the post-merge hook, which nukes the build, recompiles, and restarts Barkpark.
, which runs the canonical sequence: clean
completely, recompile, then restart the systemd Service. The wrappers
(pull + the same) encode this so nobody has to remember the steps.
The full clean is non-negotiable. A partial clean — wiping only
— leaves stale HEEx templates from the Layouts module and prod serves old HTML for hours. ASDF must be on
for the recompile to find Elixir/Erlang, which is why the systemd Service's
sources ASDF on boot. Expect a
while the BEAM comes back up.
Schema changes ship separately via Migration (
), not the post-merge hook. A code change that touches the Indx Engine index shape may need a Blue Green Rebuild afterward to repopulate
. The Caddy front door keeps serving cached TLS while the app restarts, so external callers see only a brief gap.
Always smoke-test after: hit the HTTP API v1 (
) and confirm LiveView Studio renders. A green deploy must still honour the Fresh Install Invariant — core Content Model up with all Plugins off.
